findings.description: Sorting uses string comparison, causing incorrect order for numeric strings of differing length.
findings.evidence: Example: events = [{'version':'10'}, {'version':'2'}]. Expected numeric order: [{'version':'2'}, {'version':'10'}]. Candidate returns [{'version':'10'}, {'version':'2'}].

review.summary: candidate.py incorrectly sorts version strings lexicographically instead of numerically, violating the contract for numeric ordering.
